title: Something for the Weekend
content:
Donegal mix master Colpey Calling selects his new Track of the Week, as well as the Best Track You’ve Never Heard.

Track of the Week

Boxcutter & Defcon – ‘Skylights’ (feat. Kaidi Thatham) (2014)

A fantastic crossover track between three Belfast orientated producers, Boxcutter, Defcon and Kaidi. Barry Lynn, AKA Boxcutter, does it again with another fantastic release on his Kinnego record label. The collaboration of all three artists, three different styles and inflences comes together brilliant to create a breaktaking track. A mix of groove IDM bass and footwork – make for an amazing trip! Check Kinnego records out on Bandcamp for this and previous releases: http://kinnegorecords.bandcamp.com/

Best Track You’ve Never Heard

The Cecil Holmes Soulful Sounds – ‘I’m Gonna Love Just A Little More Baby’ (1973)

That bass – ooooh! Its raw and dirty from the get go – it leds us into a groovey track that builds and builds – all in all this is pure sex music! Love is the in air on this one – amazing track.
